articles.summary: Niagen Bioscience, Inc. (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announces that senior management will participate in the 20th Annual LD Micro Main Event from Monday, October 19 to 21, 2026, in Los Angeles, CA. Niagen Bioscience Chief Executive Officer, Robert Fried, will present on Wednesday, October 21st at 1:30 p.m. PT. To register for the Niagen Bioscience webcast, please visit www.ldmicroevents.com . Chief Financial Officer, Ozan Pamir, will join Mr. Fried and be available for one-on-one meetings with institutional investors at the conference. If you would like to schedule a one-on-one meeting with the Niagen Bioscience management team during the conference, please contact your respective conference representative or email Niagen@KCSA.com . A replay of the presentation webcast will be available on the Niagen Bioscience Investor Relations website, www.investors.niagenbioscience.com ,
articles.title: Niagen Bioscience to Present at LD Micro 20th Annual Main Event
